edges.reason: initialize requires msg.sender == address(kernel) to authorize initialization
_permissionsCreator is used as entity, app and manager when creating the initial permission
onlyInit modifier reads initializationBlock to prevent re-initialization
initialize calls initialized() which is restricted to uninitialized state
initialized() sets initializationBlock using getBlockNumber()
getBlockNumber returns block.number consumed by initialized()
initialized() writes the initializationBlock state variable
initialize performs the bootstrap _createPermission call
createPermission requires msg.sender to hold CREATE_PERMISSIONS_ROLE on this contract
createPermission forwards to the internal _createPermission after the role check
_entity is hashed into the permission key written by _setPermission
_app is hashed into the permission key written by _setPermission
_role is hashed into the permission key written by _setPermission
_createPermission writes the permission via _setPermission
_createPermission assigns the manager via _setPermissionManager
_setPermission writes the params hash into the permissions mapping
_setPermissionManager writes the new manager into permissionManager
_manager is stored as manager during permission creation
grantPermissionP persists non-empty params through _saveParams
_params array is hashed and persisted by _saveParams
_encodedParams are decoded into Param structs and pushed to storage
_saveParams pushes Param entries into permissionParams
paramsHash computed in grantPermissionP is written by _setPermission
grantPermissionP applies the permission through _setPermission
revokePermission clears the permission using _setPermission
revokePermission is guarded by onlyPermissionManager which compares msg.sender
setPermissionManager is guarded by onlyPermissionManager which compares msg.sender
onlyPermissionManager modifier resolves the manager through getPermissionManager
getPermissionManager reads the permissionManager mapping
The manager returned by getPermissionManager gates setPermissionManager execution
setPermissionManager forwards to the internal _setPermissionManager
_newManager is written into the permissionManager mapping
hasPermission reads stored params hashes from the permissions mapping
whoParams determines whether the specific entity check is evaluated
anyParams enables the ANY_ENTITY wildcard fallback path
_who is hashed into the permission lookup key
_where is hashed into the permission lookup key
_what is hashed into the permission lookup key
_how parameter values are passed into evaluation
intsLength is the computed length used to reinterpret the raw bytes
hasPermission evaluates stored params via evalParam
block.timestamp is used as a permission parameter value (TIMESTAMP_PARAM_ID)
msg.sender is used as a permission parameter value (SENDER_PARAM_ID)
evalParam calls an attacker-influenced oracle address stored in permission params
evalParam compares values using the compare helper
_sender is forwarded to kernel.hasPermission for authorization
_role is forwarded as the role being checked
params are re-encoded into the how bytes passed to the kernel
canPerform uses inline assembly to force cast params to bytes
canPerform delegates authorization to the external kernel hasPermission call
msg.sender is passed as _sender by auth/authP modifiers into canPerform
The kernel address used in the authorization call is read from storage
_script drives executor resolution and calldata encoding in runScript
_input is ABI encoded into the executor calldata
_blacklist is ABI encoded into the executor calldata
executorAddr, resolved from the script registry, is the delegatecall target
runScript delegatecalls arbitrary executor code while holding app storage
protectState reads kernel before execution and re-checks it after the untrusted delegatecall
protectState reads appId before execution and re-checks it after the untrusted delegatecall
